note: Plan 4 — real-market discovery. Plan 3 proved the API: 10 pilot series resolve to real tickers, but per-strike hourly ladder markets are thin (liq $0, vol 0; flow sits on top strikes / directional series) and the most-recently-updated sweep is dominated by freshly created sports combos. So: paginate 15 x 200 markets (offset 0..2800) to build a ~3000-market cross-section; rank locally by volume_24h / liquidity for (a) the forward desk universe (active, live, with books) and (b) the backtest archive (long-dated markets whose candles reach back to the 2026-07-24 history cutoff). Next plan (5) captures candlesticks for the winners and populates universe.json so the cron forward desk starts trading against real books.
